Use case 9 — how it fires

GitHub Development Workflow Automation (Public framing): webhook in → OnCall → Code Analyzer. GitHub is both input and output. Developers tag @edge-delta on a PR, or Actions failures / the daily GitHub report workflow trigger a thread.

Term key: webhook in = GitHub event payload to Edge Delta; OnCall = router teammate; Code Analyzer = specialist that reasons about repo/CI signals; thread = channel conversation object, not an Issue card.

This tenant Observed (UI): GitHub Connected; CI / PR / Push Event Threshold monitors No Data; daily GitHub risk report has fired every day since 14 Aug (latest: 17 Aug 05:34, 391.1 K tokens, Software Engineer, Resolved). Full thread: edgedelta-uc9-github-2026-08-17.md.

Use case 10 — write-up (after Fabric)

Not a new vendor. Native Edge Delta MCP (schema + CQL on data shaped at the edge) vs a third-party MCP (e.g. Elastic ES|QL). Execute only after a real Issue exists. Details: markdown §6.
